high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a social media post from a user named "Winter-Leadership986," who shared the information 16 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The post is titled "Politicians killed in Mexico since the start of 2024." Map: The central element of the image is a map of Mexico. The map is divided into states, with each state outlined in white against a light gray background. Red Pins: Red location pins are placed on various parts of the map, indicating the locations where politicians have been killed.
